turns.message: I placed a prepaid order on Amazon on September 26, 2024 for a Wakefit orthopedic mattress. The listed price was ₹9,799 but I paid ₹8,819.10 after a bank discount, using my Visa card online. The shipment was not delivered on time, so I contacted Delhivery, the delivery partner, and they suggested cancelling the order through an OTP. The order was cancelled on October 7, 2024. Tracking shows the mattress went back to the seller and reached Faridabad on October 16, 2024. Amazon told me the refund would be processed, but the app shows a total expected refund of ₹0.00 and nothing has been credited, even after repeated emails and phone calls.

expected.rationale: Refund pending (not received), exact cancellation date, support contacted by email and phone, grievance officer not mentioned.
